history.summary: A 623 sqft freehold 1BR at The Verve (D12 Balestier/Boon Keng, built 2012) at $899k / $1,443 psf — notably ~10% below the $1,609 district median. Freehold, sub-$1M quantum and a real PSF discount are attractive, though the 3.5%/yr appreciation (34 txns) is modest and the 1.08km MRT walk softens rental pull.
history.rating_rationale: PSF $1,443 vs $1,609 median is a genuine ~10% discount on a freehold city-fringe 1BR with a credible 34-txn series — that value gap plus sub-$1M quantum and broad rental demand (city-fringe D12, Novena/CBD access) gives a sensible entry with room to close to median. Appreciation is only OCR-ish at 3.5%/yr and Toa Payoh MRT is a 1.08km walk, so it's a Buy on value/yield rather than a growth standout.
red_flags: Modest 3.5%/yr appreciation — value play, not a growth engine
1.08km to nearest MRT — weaker rental convenience than doorstep stations
1BR niche owner-occupier demand in a city-fringe locale
catalysts: Freehold and ~10% below district median PSF — real value gap
Sub-$1M quantum keeps the buyer pool deep
City-fringe D12 with Novena/CBD and Balestier amenity access
